tiebreakers.description: Higher credit sum (total purchase price of bonds) in the nation with the most power points; then the nation with the second most power points, and so on

notes: family: area-majority (investment). Game ends as soon as any nation reaches 25 power points. Power Factor is read from the scoring track above each nation's power points (5 power points per step, e.g. 17 points = factor 3). A bond's value = its interest x Power Factor; 1 million = 1 VP. Interest per bond is printed on the bond card (enter the sum of your bonds in that nation). Tiebreaker needs bond credit sums per nation (not modelled as inputs).
